designSupplement.purpose: Retain a passive same-job/same-operation lookup target after composition page or tab loss; no replayable payload is persisted.
designSupplement.experience: After current authentication, re-open shared compose or Eve remix; confirmation card locks new operations until the same saved operation is verified by GET. Unsaved text/quote/consent is lost.
designSupplement.responsibility: ROCK client validation and lifecycle; existing server authentication/owner-scoped GET remains authority. EXTERNAL browser storage availability; no paid provider dependency.
designSupplement.inputsOutputs: Closed version1 record: owner scope, canonical job UUID, operation UUID, kind(create/composition/command), base revision, SHA256 operation fingerprint. Current owner-scoped API read model is the only result source.
designSupplement.states: No marker -> explicit existing write may persist a marker before dispatch. Unknown marker -> GET-only pending after reload. Exact matched readback + fresh owner -> clear matching marker. 404/mismatch/401/invalid metadata/storage failure remain unresolved.
designSupplement.storage: Reuse readOwnerScope, pendingOwnerStatus and openZemaPrivateStorage with explicit browser localStorage. New namespaced owner key; no original texts, source descriptor, raw quote, file, credential, note, approval or execution grant. No TTL removal of unknown results. Browser profile persistence, not cross-device/account-server backup.
designSupplement.failure: Invalid owner/ID/extra fields/digest/revision or unreadable storage blocks new writes. Failed storage write/readback prevents dispatch. Nonmatching or failed deletion retains pending. Compare-before-save/clear prevents simple stale overwrite, but is not a cross-tab atomic lock.
designSupplement.recovery: Explicit resumed confirmation uses current owner -> same exact job GET -> stored operation witness/fingerprint -> current owner again. Confirmed historical create/run/cancel is a saved-state read; no new run, no expiry-based replay, no replacement ID. Missing operation audit or noncommitted marker cannot be resolved without authoritative evidence.
designSupplement.approval: Recovered metadata is untrusted lookup intent, never authentication or write authority. No consent restored. Fresh writes continue through existing explicit UI consent, current revision, estimate expiry and existing API contracts.
designSupplement.acceptance: One baseline lost-create/reload counterexample fails; fixed related103/103 pass including owner A/B, stale handler, ID/digest/extra-field tampering, repeated404/reload, expired committed preparation create, cancelled job/material retention, lost run ack, quota refusal and unmount. Standard typecheck/target lint/diff pass. Independent Astra/high final review is required and pending.
designSupplement.openDecision: Central review must decide this bounded EVE-13 slice, integrate design/index/service/workstream and progress metadata in same adopted change, run full verify/exact head+merge SHA CI. Actual browser localStorage/tab-close, real authenticated API persistence, multi-tab atomic exclusivity, all Eve entrypoints, provider/finance/native/public acceptance are not established. Do not drop unresolved markers or add automatic replay to avoid a stuck lookup.
